## Implementation and tests
List commands actually executed, results and limitations. Distinguish IMPLEMENTED,
TESTED, EXPERIMENTAL and PLANNED. Link public-safe reproduction instructions.

## Evidence
For metrics: definition, source, period, deduplication and verification method.
Synthetic examples do not establish community impact.

## Compatibility and security
Describe breaking changes, retained interfaces and unresolved gate findings.
Do not paste raw scan output containing sensitive values. Do not bypass a failing gate.

## Review checklist
- [ ] Meaningful tests and applicable security scans executed
- [ ] Diff and filenames reviewed for secrets, personal data and protected material
- [ ] Evidence is public-approved and limitations are factual
- [ ] No Git history rewrite or deployed-resource changes
- [ ] Owner publication authorization confirmed
